notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}
Resolve the Uthros Research Craft trigger, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
